name: @matperez/coderag-mcp

tools.name: codebase_search
tools.description:
Keyword search across the codebase using TF-IDF ranking. Use specific terms, function names, or technical keywords.

**IMPORTANT: Use this tool PROACTIVELY before starting work, not reactively when stuck.**

This tool finds files containing your exact search terms, ranked by relevance.

When to use:
- **Find specific functions**: "getUserById", "handleAuth"
- **Find error messages**: "ECONNREFUSED", "TypeError"
- **Find imports/exports**: "export const", "import { Router }"

**Best Practice**: Use specific keywords, function names, or exact terms.

query.description: Keyword search query - use specific terms, function names, or technical keywords

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

include_content.description: Include file content snippets in results (default: true)

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each matched line (default: 3)

tools.name: get_indexing_status
tools.description: Returns current codebase indexing status for UI (e.g. status bar). Poll periodically to show progress. Response is JSON: isIndexing, progress, totalFiles, processedFiles, totalChunks, indexedChunks, currentFile; when not indexing, includes indexedCount.

instructions: MCP server providing keyword-based code search using TF-IDF
